notes.title: The Light Shall Triumph [Faction]
notes.notes:
[h2]The Holy Crusaders[/h2]

[i]In the darkest corners of a broken world, a golden banner still flies.[/i]

Where others fell into madness, corruption, or despair, the Holy Crusaders rose—unyielding and pure. These noble feline paladins and battle-priests wield the divine light not just as weapon, but as creed. Born from ancient oaths and sacred flames, their paws carry both healing and judgment.

They do not negotiate with evil.
They burn it from the roots.

In the cataclysm that tore through time and shattered empires, many sought power through chaos. The Crusaders, however, turned to the sky. From gleaming citadels and hallowed temples, they descend upon the battlefield in radiant armor, guided by celestial visions and absolute faith.

The light is not kind.
It is just.

⚔️ Faction Theme:
The Holy Crusaders focus on healing, buffing, and righteous retaliation—thriving in sustained combat and mid-to-late game power spikes through divine spells and protective units.

🌟 Signature Card – Holy Renewal:
Restore 2 Health to a chosen ally.
Simple, sacred, and essential—this healing spell reinforces your board and sustains your divine mission.
[hr][/hr]

[i]This is not just a faction. This is divine retribution, clad in gold.[/i]

notes.title: The Dead Rise [Faction]
notes.notes:
[h2]The Graveborn Legion[/h2]

[i]In the shadows of broken worlds, they march once more.[/i]

Long before the factions fractured and war ignited across time, there was death—and from that death came the Graveborn Legion. Not born of flesh, but of bone, spirit, and the sheer will to persist, these feline revenants were once priests, scholars, and generals of the early cat civilizations, forged by Nachtsturm’s dark vision.

But something went terribly wrong.

When the cosmic rift tore reality apart, it didn’t just birth new life—it disturbed the old. Deep in the forgotten crypts of the first kingdoms, corpses stirred. Whispers crept through sealed tombs. And so the Graveborn Legion awakened—not with memories, but with a singular, spectral hunger:
[b]To reclaim the world they were once promised.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[b]💀 Faction Theme:[/b]
The Graveborn Legion thrives on death, decay, and relentless pressure—overwhelming foes with hordes of expendable minions, devastating spell damage, and constant resurrection.

[b]🪦 Signature Card – Call of the Crypts:[/b]
Summons 1/1 zombie cats. Ideal for early-game swarm control, and the perfect setup for death-synergy strategies.

[hr][/hr]

[i]This is no mere faction. This is an ancient army... with a bone to pick.[/i]

notes.title: Backstory [3]
notes.notes:
[h2]Cosmic Rift and Mutation[/h2]
At a critical juncture in history, a cosmic rift tore through reality, unleashing unpredictable mutations and warping the very fabric of existence. New and diverse feline races emerged, each bearing unique abilities and traits shaped by the chaotic energies of the rift. Some viewed this event as an opportunity to advance the original mission, believing in patience and subtlety to eventually manipulate history into fulfilling Nachtsturm's goal. Others, however, saw the rift as a sign of destiny—a call for feline supremacy over the known universe, casting aside the original plan in favor of outright domination.

[h2]The Great War Ignites[/h2]
This ideological divide sparked the Great War, a conflict spanning worlds, dimensions, and entire epochs. The factions clashed in a battle of wits, power, and belief, shaping the fate of the cosmos. Would the followers of the original mission prevail, maintaining their silent guidance from the shadows? Or would the forces of feline conquest rise, seeking to claim the universe as their own?

[h2]The Unraveling of Reality[/h2]
As history unraveled, the fate of all existence rested on the warring factions of a once-unified feline empire, their struggle determining the destiny of not just their own kind, but the very nature of reality itself.

notes.title: Backstory [2]
notes.notes:
[h2]Time Mishap[/h2]
[b]A specially bred and rigorously trained feline operative was selected for this task—a sleek, enigmatic white cat named [i]Nachtsturm[/i].[/b] However, something went wrong during the time travel process. Instead of arriving in the early 1930s, Nachtsturm was sent back thousands of years into the past, landing in an era where primitive humans roamed the world.

[h2]Adaptation and Legacy[/h2]
As the smartest creature of that time, Nachtsturm quickly adapted to his new reality. Understanding that his mission was of utmost importance, he sought ways to improve the felines of that era. Over centuries, he selectively bred and taught the native cats, gradually increasing their intelligence and forming the foundation of an advanced secret society. With time, these cats became more sophisticated, developing language, tools, and eventually, anthropomorphic traits that allowed them to move, strategize, and manipulate the world like humans.

[h2]Rise of the Feline Civilization[/h2]
Through patience and ingenuity, Nachtsturm laid the groundwork for a hidden feline civilization that would guide history from the shadows. Over thousands of years, as their society flourished, numerous factions emerged, each with their own vision of the future. Humanity, as it was once known, never evolved into the dominant species. Instead, the world became one shaped and ruled by the descendants of Nachtsturm's creations.

[h1] Operation Katzengeist: A Last-Ditch Effort [/h1]

[b]In the final years of World War II[/b], as Nazi Germany faced inevitable defeat, its top scientists and strategists launched a bold, desperate plan to rewrite history.

[b]Operation Katzengeist[/b] was a radical initiative that combined [b]genetic engineering[/b] with [b]time manipulation[/b]. The goal? To create a superior breed of feline operatives—[i]intelligent, resourceful, and stealthy[/i]—capable of influencing human affairs across generations.

[h2] Meet the Shadow Paws [/h2]

These enhanced cats, codenamed [b]"Die Schattenpfoten"[/b] (The Shadow Paws), were not ordinary felines. They were trained as master infiltrators with:
[list]
[*] [b]Heightened intellect[/b]
[*] [b]Near-supernatural agility[/b]
[*] An uncanny ability to [b]blend into human society[/b]
[/list]
Their secret mission was to travel back in time and establish a clandestine society that could guide the course of history, ensuring that Nazi ideology would triumph through subtle manipulation rather than overt conflict.
